mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, category, description, content, source_type, image_url, tags, visibility, like_count, favorite_count, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM knowledge_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.title, n.category, n.description, n.content, n.source_type, n.image_url, n.tags, n.visibility, n.like_count, n.favorite_count, n.create_time, n.update_time, n.deleted FROM knowledge_note n INNER JOIN knowledge_note_reaction r ON r.note_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.reaction_type = 'FAVORITE' AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT
FROM knowledge_note WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_note ( user_id, title, category, description, content, source_type, image_url, tags, visibility, like_count, favorite_count, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{description}, #{content}, #{sourceType}, #{imageUrl}, #{tags}, #{visibility}, #{likeCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_note SET like_count = like_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_note SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_note SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_note SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
